summary: ModelService.createModel reads files.eol per resource (_getEOL, modelService.ts:184-191) to set defaultEOL; model-service.create-model / text-model.add-model keep no EOL option and no files-eol config exists.

ViewController.dispatchMouse (viewController.ts:259-276) double-click selects bracket content when doubleClickSelectsBlock is on; the model has no dispatchMouse, cursors-controller holds no selection, and _wordSelect only records the source.

The asserted 14 ranges come from the built-in bracket and word selection providers scanning the text; that is below the model. The scenario only checks the selectionRange query reaches the feature registry (passes).

TextSearchManager hands the provider folderOptions.encoding = toCanonicalName(fileEncoding) (common/textSearchManager.ts:223); ext-host-search.provide-text-search-results is a bodiless stub with no TextSearchManager, and SearchTextQuery (files-search-scm) has no per-folder fileEncoding.
text-file-service.create without a value writes a 0-byte file through working-copy-file-service.create and file-service.create-file; read-file returns size 0.

Round 2: passes after the fix round. Extra case: textFileService.create encodes value into contents and passes it on (textFileService.ts:253-263, workingCopyFileService.ts:372); text-file-service.create drops input.value, so the file is created empty instead of 'Hello World'.
With files.autoSave=afterDelay and delay 1, an edit makes main.ts dirty, editor-auto-save saves it with reason auto, the model ends not dirty and the disk holds 'Super Good'.

Round 2: passes after the fix round. workbench.action.browser.newTab and .open (browserTabManagementFeatures.ts:341-345, 433-437) open the URL picker only without a URL; neither command is modeled or registered, so try-execute-command fails command-not-found.
getIssueReporterScreenshotFile (issueReporterMedia.ts:52-56) is a pure helper parsing a data URL's MIME type into a file name; below the model.
promoteActiveLanguage (configureSnippets.ts:148-167) reorders quick-pick items in place; the model abstracts the Configure Snippets pick as a choice, so item order is presentation below the model.
Round 2: getSourceActions caches per notebook; closing drops the cache, so the reopened notebook is built with the current context ([false,true]).
notebook.cell.moveDown on cell 1 applies a move edit; handle 2 ('var b = 1;') ends at index 2 and focus moves to 2, as moveCellRange does (cellOperations.ts:243-262).
notebook.cellOutput.copy writes the text/plain output 'output content' to clipboard-service.

Round 2: passes after the fix round. Extra case: copyCellOutput copies only a TEXT_BASED_MIMETYPES item (cellOutputTextHelper.ts:109-119); notebook-cell-output-actions.cmd-notebook-celloutput-copy copies outputs[0].value whatever its mime, so 'output content' (mime 'bad') reaches the clipboard.
